title: Around the World in 80 Days
description: Phileas Fogg lives by the clock and is never late. At his club he makes a wager — and that same evening sets out with his manservant Passepartout. Trains, steamers, an elephant — and a detective who is certain that Fogg is a bank robber.
line: A wager of twenty thousand pounds: to go round the globe in eighty days.
source: after the novel by Jules Verne
